name: simlease
description: Stop coding agents from fighting over the same iOS Simulator or Android emulator.

interface.shortDescription: Stop coding agents fighting over one device
interface.longDescription: Use several coding agents on one Mac without device conflicts. SimLease gives each task its own iOS Simulator or Android emulator and slims Simulators with simslim, so builds, tests, and app previews don't interrupt each other.
defaultPrompt: Use SimLease before running this work on an iOS Simulator.
Run my Android app on its own leased emulator.
Show which Simulators and emulators are leased right now.
